description: Wallet / counterparty screen before you send funds or accept a payer: OFAC SDN sanctioned-address check (EVM list, refreshed from the 0xB10C OFAC dataset), address type (EOA, EIP-7702 delegated, contract, token contract), Base and Ethereum tx counts, ETH/USDC balances on Base, burn-address detection and an optional address-poisoning look-alike check against the address you expected (same first/last 4 hex). Verdict block/high_risk/caution/no_red_flags. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

expected.description: optional: the address you meant to use (detects address-poisoning look-alikes)

name: wallet_screen
